scope: InventoryStockStatusMixSeeder cohort selection and atomic opening evidence
WarehouseOperationsCoverageSeeder cancelled reversal replay and fresh-item lifecycle cohort
Isolated fixture authentication and protected-database regression tests

stock_mix.selection: Choose the initial cohort under a warehouse advisory transaction lock; do not choose the next no-stock cohort on each replay.
stock_mix.atomicity: Opening movements and their balance changes commit together; an unexpected error rolls back the entire cohort.
stock_mix.legacy: Any existing SEED-STKMIX movement in the warehouse preserves the existing cohort without adding or repairing rows. This is NOT a proof that a historical interrupted seed completed.
stock_mix.availability: Non-AVAILABLE fixture buckets do not increase available quantity.
stock_mix.warehouse: Exact KHO-TONG-HN only; missing reference is not permission to use the first warehouse.

operations.reversal: Existing DRAFT, POSTED or CANCELLED reversal history prevents the seeder from creating another reversal for the same original movements. Business-owner retry permissions and commands are unchanged.
operations.item_lifecycle: Only exact new item IDs produced by successful receipt posting in the current invocation are eligible for the lifecycle sample. Pre-existing IDs and unrelated operational items are not a fresh sample; the in-memory cohort is consumed once.
operations.coverage_limit: These targeted changes do not certify every phase or backfill of WarehouseOperationsCoverageSeeder or the default DatabaseSeeder chain.

protected_database.policy: Both changed seeders reject protected deployment databases before querying, regardless of fixture credentials or the separate protected-seed permission flag.
protected_database.preflight: Existing wms:seed-preflight remains configuration-only. Missing fixture credentials or explicit runtime coverage remain blockers, not defaults to fill automatically.

validation.candidate_only: Prepared candidate passed targeted tests; final commit must pass its own exact-SHA workflow.
validation.temporary_table_checks: 58 PostgreSQL replay/rollback/protected-guard assertions, plus the existing 11 component display-backfill immutability assertions. These use isolated temporary tables, not the deployed schema or a full seed chain.
validation.migrated_schema_checks: SeedReplayFixtureContractTest, SeedPreflightTest, P12ReadRevision2Test and P13NotificationRevision2Test on isolated PostgreSQL and SQLite. Stock-mix writes are PostgreSQL-only; SQLite verifies the unsupported-driver no-op.
validation.fixture_login: AuthDatabaseSeeder fixture -> browser login -> GET auth/me -> logout -> old token denied. Test credentials are local and must not be exported.
validation.evidence: Required nonempty JUnit results and source/report hashes in workflow log and summary. No dependency lock update, artifact-quota bypass of tests or release claim.

release_boundaries.reported_deployment: The supplied DEV/TEST report describes eaa8fd2f plus 14 retained runtime overlays, not a bare-source artifact. Those overlay contents and local evidence have not been imported or certified by this change.
release_boundaries.no_runtime_mutations: This change contains no live seed, database repair, rollback, deployment or runtime overlay update.
next_review: Reconcile and review the per-file manifest and diffs of all 14 runtime overlays before preparing a new release.
